parameters.content:
## Add a document

Open the form at `http://127.0.0.1:5678/form/add-document`, pick a file (.pdf, .docx, .txt or .md) and send it.

1. **Upload form** shows the page and receives the file
2. **Check the file** rejects wrong types, empty or oversized files and cleans up the name
3. **Save into docs** writes it into the `docs` folder (a file with the same name is replaced)
4. The chat server notices the new file within about 10 seconds and indexes it

The folder is set at the top of the **Check the file** box. n8n may only write there because `start-n8n.ps1` allows the `docs` folder.

parameters.formDescription: Choose a PDF, Word (.docx), text (.txt) or Markdown (.md) file. It is saved into the docs folder and becomes searchable in the chat within about 10 seconds. A file with the same name is replaced.

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ $('Check the file').item.json.safeName }} is now in the docs folder. The chat will be able to answer from it in about 10 seconds.
